Independently design and render a complex randomized photographic test scene using the attached person as appearance reference, then test visual realization. The hillside transit location and infrastructure staging are agent-authored choices, with coordinator-owned outdoor family guidance.

Create a natural editorial photograph of one adult woman at a terraced hillside bus interchange on an overcast morning after rain. Use the attached portrait as her facial appearance and hair reference: retain the softly oval face, dark brown eyes, full natural lips, and long loose dark wavy hair. She wears a charcoal weatherproof coat over a cream knit top, straight dark trousers and practical ankle boots. She pauses on a broad concrete stair landing, both boot soles resting flat on the same level surface, her left hand lightly wrapped around the waist-high metal handrail beside her left hip while her right hand holds a small canvas tote beside her right thigh. Her torso turns a little toward the camera, with a quiet attentive expression. Both forearms and the hand-to-rail contact remain visible. The rail continues down the adjacent stairs, leaving clear standing space around her feet. Show her full figure within a spacious architectural view. A foreground drainage grate meets the landing edge; the stairs rise behind her to a steel and glass bus shelter; a retaining wall and hillside apartment facades occupy successively deeper planes. Concrete stair joints, tile paving seams and shelter posts retain consistent perspective and human scale. Rain darkens sheltered concrete unevenly, with a shallow puddle beside the drain and small scuffs along the handrail. Glass panels transmit the structures behind them and catch the pale sky. Soft overhead daylight reaches her face and the surrounding construction with matching direction and restrained contrast. Keep the ordinary infrastructure legible across the image, with believable material surfaces and continuous geometry. The result should feel like a candid photograph made at an actual working transit stop.

Do not assign fixed hair color, eye color, hairstyle, costume, gender, occupation, gaze direction, camera angle, or prop, and do not let expressionlessness, competence, beauty, a cool palette, or a caring object substitute for the same-target action and consequence. render_gates.description: The subject and any relationship counterpart are unmistakably adult fictional people, while the requested identity, role, and styling remain intact.
A calm low-expression baseline remains immediately legible without becoming hostile, frightened, vacant, or broadly cheerful.
The quiet support action and localized warmth clearly point to one identifiable trusted adult counterpart rather than everyone in the scene.
One practical target-directed act is concretely readable and is not replaced by an adjective, gaze, costume, role, or caring prop alone.
Exactly one restrained facial, hand, or shoulder region softens toward the trusted counterpart while the rest of the composed baseline remains stable.
An already-visible helpful consequence belongs to the same counterpart, such as relief, restored comfort, or resumed activity.
Stable composure, selective warmth, practical support, and its same-target consequence coexist in one still without an abrupt personality reversal.
Hair, eyes, costume, gender, role, posture, and muted or cool styling remain optional; none is accepted as archetype proof without the relationship behavior.
